lines: Cornered by a large number of drones, one of them hit me in the leg and knocked me off balance.
You're taking your eye off the ball!
(That Major, or whatever she's called, is nothing to sneeze at. Is she a cyborg?! What the hell does she want with me!?)
Even while I was trying to analyze the situation, I was surrounded by drones, and finally I was left unable to move.
Alright! Take out the young lord's knees and hold him hostage!
I braced myself for the pain.
The ones being taken out were the drones.
Tokiko!! What are you doing here!?
Tokiko's kunai were precisely aiming for the drones' weak spots, and within a minute they had been turned into piles of junk.
I was watching you with my Clairvoyant Eye so you didn't cheat, Master♪
"Clairvoyant Eye" was Tokiko's Evil Eye that allowed her to project her field of view to a faraway location.
Sheesh... so you don't trust me at all...
It's because of your everyday actions.
But thanks to those actions, I was saved! So my everyday actions are important!
Tch, the head family's butler? What's adding one more person going to do for you?!
(One more person makes a huge difference... Especially in this situation!)
